MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 12
   D. 10

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

5. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 32

6. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 16

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

11. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. B — 3/4

2. C — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. D — 10
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²
3. c² = 36 + 64
4. c² = 100
5. c = 10
Final Answer: 10 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
